Test "Consumer Preference Survey for Garden Tractor Purchase" between T1; T2. Method: Online survey with simulated purchase scenarios. Recruit 500 U.S. homeowners (250 urban, 250 suburban) via a panel. Randomly assign participants to one of two scenarios: (A) price‑sensitive scenario emphasizing low cost and multiple‑use functionality; (B) status‑driven scenario emphasizing prestige, modern lifestyle, and brand image. Participants indicate their likelihood to purchase (1‑10) and the primary reason for purchase (multiple choice).. Sample: 500 U.S. homeowners (250 urban, 250 suburban) recruited via an online panel, stratified by geographic region.. Measure: Average purchase likelihood score (1‑10) and primary reason selection (price vs status).. Predictions: T1: In price‑sensitive scenario, average likelihood will be ≥ 7 and price/multiple‑use will be the top reason (selected by ≇ 55% of participants).; T2: In status‑driven scenario, average likelihood will be ≥ 7 and status/prestige will be the top reason (selected by ≇ 55% of participants).. Decision rule: If average likelihood in price‑sensitive scenario ≥ 7 and price/multiple‑use is top reason → T1 is more likely. If average likelihood in status‑driven scenario ≥ 7 and status/prestige is top reason → T2 is more likely. If neither scenario meets threshold → evidence insufficient to justify investment. If both meet threshold → further. Cost: 15000 euros, 10 weeks.

Predictions: In a test offering a fashion-styled earplug at a price point 20% above standard protective models, purchase intent among target consumers will be at least 15% higher than for a standard protective model.; Willingness to pay will be positively correlated with perceived style appeal as measured by a survey scale..

Who benefits: Individual consumers who use hearing protection for music, podcasts, or gaming and seek high-fidelity audio.. Sample: 300 participants (150 per condition) recruited from a panel of general consumers interested in personal safety or lifestyle products.. Measure: Primary outcome: average willingness to pay (WTP) for each condition. Secondary: purchase intent (binary: would buy vs would not buy).. Predictions: T1: Average WTP for lifestyle condition will be at least 15% higher than for audio condition, and purchase intent for lifestyle condition will be at least 10% higher.; T2: Average WTP for audio condition will be at least 15% higher than for lifestyle condition, and purchase intent for audio condition will be at least 10% higher.. If neither condition meets its thresholds, conclude evidence is insufficient to justify investment.. Cost: 18000 euros, 10 weeks.
